topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: Oh no, can you even believe it? I just got the news and it’s like, what? The place where we always go, where they remember our faces and our orders without even trying? That one corner spot we always snag, even on the busiest nights? It’s been there forever, like a part of the neighborhood, you know? And now this. I keep thinking there must be some mistake, that they’ll pull out of this, somehow. But what if they don’t? How are things going to be the same without it? I’m not ready for this, and I’m sure you’re not either. We’ve got to talk about this, figure out what we can do. Maybe there’s a way to save it?
